data.description:
## Context
Story: b688-c0f9-2a98-4063 — DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING comment written at sub-branch creation; COMPACTION_RESUME reads it

## Goal
Update SKILL.md: (1) add DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING comment instruction at Phase F and Phase G sub-branch creation; (2) extend COMPACTION_RESUME fence to read most-recent DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING: comment with exact-prefix match.

## Testing Mode: UPDATE

## File Impact
| Source File | Action | Test File | Classification |
|---|---|---|---|
| plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md | modify | tests/scripts/test-debug-everything-branch-tracking.sh | needs-modification |
| .test-index | modify | n/a | n/a |

## Implementation Steps
1. At Phase F sub-branch creation step: after 'git checkout -b' or branch creation, add:
   .claude/scripts/dso ticket comment <epic-id> "DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING: sub_branch=<name> tier=<N> batch=<K> timestamp=<UTC>"
   (K=0 for Phase F tier-0 and tier-1 single batches)

2. At Phase G sub-branch creation step: same DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING comment with actual batch index K

3. Find COMPACTION_RESUME section in SKILL.md and add:
   After compaction detection, before any commit or fix-bug dispatch, read the most-recent DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING: comment:
   ```bash
   _tracking=$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket comment-list <epic-id> 2>/dev/null | grep '^DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING: ' | tail -1)
   ```
   - Parser uses exact-prefix match: 'DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING: ' (note the space) — NOT substring match, does NOT match WORKTREE_TRACKING: or any other sprint anchor
   - If found: parse sub_branch=<name> and checkout that branch before any work
   - If not found (no tracking comment exists): proceed on session branch (no active sub-branch to recover)
   - Add note: 'regression test verifies parser isolation from sprint WORKTREE_TRACKING: comments'

4. Remove RED markers for test_debug_branch_tracking_* and test_compaction_resume_reads_debug_tracking from .test-index

## Acceptance Criteria
- SKILL.md Phase F contains DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING: sub_branch= tier= batch= timestamp= comment instruction
- SKILL.md Phase G contains the same DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING comment instruction
- SKILL.md COMPACTION_RESUME references reading most-recent 'DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING:' comment
- SKILL.md states exact-prefix match (not substring)
- SKILL.md states parser does NOT match WORKTREE_TRACKING:
- All 6 structural tests pass GREEN
- ruff checks pass
